Captured QuickTime USB protocol fixtures from iPhoneMirror's Core tests:
https://github.com/RayrenSX/iPhoneMirror/tree/31acd8a78e7038d46c7e1a6ee987b9035cf36dde/src/Core/tests/fixtures/quicktime_video_hack
Original provenance and licenses are retained in the bundled upstream source archive under resources/usb/source/.
The replay validates actual native session replies, H.264 extraction and PCM conversion without claiming a physical USB connection.
